thread_analysis.thread_summary: Internal Allion RF test report review (Kei Tanaka, Kousuke Nakayama, Itsuo Sakai) for a Toytec project, October 2024. The thread documents internal QC corrections to a draft RF test report (address correction, a spelling fix) and resolves an apparent conformance-requirement discrepancy by checking the registration's actual declared ICS.
all_questions_found: Should an additional 3-DH1 measurement have been included, given the test log appears to show 3Mbps support? (see thread_0049_case_01)

(Administrative, not separately cased) Minor report corrections -- an incomplete address (missing Tochigi prefecture) and a spelling typo (MibPower should be MinPower) -- routine internal QC without generalizable technical content.
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: Case_01 documents a useful internal report-review methodology: resolving an apparent test-log-driven conformance trigger by deferring to the registration's actual declared/inherited ICS in the Test Plan, rather than taking the test log's surface appearance at face value.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: See thread_0049_case_01 for case-specific decision logic.
thread_analysis.consulting_mistake: None identified -- this is a normal, functioning internal QC review catching genuine minor errors (address, spelling) and correctly resolving a more substantive apparent discrepancy.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Internal report reviewers should always verify apparent conformance-requirement triggers against the registration's actual declared ICS in the Test Plan rather than relying on a surface read of the test log alone.
